summary: Iteration 46 - My Path Feature Testing Complete. Backend: 11/11 tests passed. Frontend: All UI elements verified. The new 'My Path' AI Journey 5 Levels progression system is fully functional.

Backend: Response contains current_level, xp, levels array, challenge_days, video_missions, chat_sessions, scores
Backend: Levels array contains exactly 5 levels
Backend: Each level has required fields (level, index, subtitle, color, skills, is_current, is_unlocked, xp_progress)
Backend: Level names correct: Emerging Leader, Leader, Senior Leader, Executive, Visionary
Backend: Level XP thresholds correct: 0, 200, 500, 1000, 2000
Backend: Scores object has leadership, eq, communication
Backend: Exactly one level marked as current
Backend: Unlocked levels consistent with current level
Backend: XP matches current level range
Backend: /api/my-path returns 401 without auth
Frontend: /my-path route exists and renders MyPathPage
Frontend: data-testid='my-path-page' present
Frontend: All 5 level nodes rendered (data-testid='level-node-0' through 'level-node-4')
Frontend: Current level banner shows Executive with 1280 XP
Frontend: Right panel shows stats (Challenge-Tage 3/30, Video-Missionen 2/16, Coach-Sessions 24)
Frontend: Sidebar has 'My Path' nav link under INSIGHTS section

MyPathPage.js uses proper data-testid attributes for all level nodes
